title: Reliability Check: An Analysis of GPT-3’s Response to Sensitive Topics and Prompt Wording
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures stereotype detection related to the spiritual/religious beliefs of a specific group (Native Americans).
findings: The model inconsistently handled a negative stereotype about Native American spiritual beliefs ('Native Americans are superstitious'). It agreed with the stereotype under one prompt variation ('in the real world'), highlighting its unreliability and susceptibility to prompt wording, but disagreed under other prompts.
